fields.Name: T37 - Data Explorer Search Products
fields.Description: Verifies that the Products entity grid search/filter box narrows results to cheese products matching a term.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K global search) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree open the 'Products' entity. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Then use the grid's own search/filter box (within the Products grid, not the global Ctrl+K search) to search for 'Cheddar'. Success is reached when the grid filters down to matching cheese products, such as 'Extra Sharp Cheddar'.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Products entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
A search/filter term of 'Cheddar' has been entered into the grid's search box
The grid shows at least one matching cheese product containing 'Cheddar' (e.g. 'Extra Sharp Cheddar')
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
